text:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: Paging: SRE on-call (sre_oncall) — High GPU queue growth in ap-southeast-1, autoscaler errors detected. Priority: P1.

sre_oncall: On it. Seeing queue 25k, 99th latency 4.2s. Autoscaler logs show repeated scalingFailures: "scaling limit reached".

maria_eng: Confirming — metrics show GpuPool-asia-primary at 100% alloc, queue increasing for last 18m. Spillover routing should've redirected to eu-west, but requests still routing to asia.

aj_infra: I can see routing agent returning 503 for a subset. Looks like the spillover policy didn't trigger because the region health checks are passing but capacity flags are set to saturated.

kevin_api: That explains API errors customers are seeing — we have a small percentage of requests getting throttled and retries aren't backing off. Which customers impacted?

beth_support: Several paying customers reported elevated 429/503. Ticket #4521 for AcmeAI, 4519 for BrightForms — both have bursty traffic in APAC.

elena_ops: I'm running the runbook now: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-exhaustion. Step 1: verify autoscaler error details. Step 2: check routing policy.

sre_oncall: Paste logs: ```
autoscaler: error=scaleUpRejected reason=maxPoolSizeReached pool=GpuPool-asia-primary current=32 max=32
router: decision=route_primary percent=92 spillover=false
```

maria_eng: So autoscaler hit configured max. Was max set intentionally low for cost controls?

aj_infra: Yes, committed capacity for asia is 32 GPUs. Autoscaler respects reserve and will not exceed. We have burst (ephemeral) capacity but that path is failing due to quota in the cloud account. I'm opening cloud console.

kevin_api: If cloud quota blocked ephemeral, can we enable cross-region spillover to ap-northeast or eu immediately? I'd rather route more to eu.

elena_ops: Spillover policy is weighted, but router only triggers when health checks indicate region degraded. Right now health checks are green (nodes are up) but they're all full. We need to flip policy to allow "capacity-based spillover" instead of health-based.

sre_oncall: Quick mitigation plan: 1) Update router to capacity-based fallback (force) 2) Enable degraded-mode routing to EU 3) Apply emergency rate limit for free-tier requests 4) Notify customers and apply support mitigations.

beth_support: I'll draft a customer-facing note. Suggest we throttle low-priority and provide ETA.

aj_infra: Pushing router config now: `curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/routing -d '{"force_spillover":true,"target_regions":["eu-west-1","ap-northeast-1"]}'` — patch applied.

incident_bot: Router config change detected by deploy-bot: deploy_id=deploy-7863 user=aj_infra status=success

maria_eng: After forcing spillover, we see routing mix shift: asia 35% -> 12%, eu 52%, ap-northeast 36% (some double-counting due to sticky sessions). Queue in asia stopped growing. 50% of queued requests drained after 3 minutes.

kevin_api: Great. Are we observing any latency regressions in EU due to cold caches/kv misses?

maria_eng: 99p token latency in eu spiked to 6.8s for ~8 minutes while KV caches filled; now down to 2.1s. We should expect some transient quality/perf delta.

elena_ops: Next: request temporary quota increase for ephemeral GPUs in ap-southeast cloud account (ticket opened). If approved, we can scale primary up and shift traffic back.

aj_infra: Ticket submitted to cloud: INC-9982, requested +8 GPUs temporary burst. ETA unknown (~2-8h).

beth_support: Customer update posted to status page draft: "Degraded performance in APAC; mitigation in progress. Some requests may see higher latency or errors. Engineers routing traffic to EU."

cust_success_jose: Flagging enterprise customers with dedicated capacity — AcmeAI has dedicated fleet in asia but overflowed due to misprediction. We're offering them emergency credits.

sre_oncall: Observability note — add a synthetic alert for capacity saturation (not just health checks). Current rule only looks at instance health, not utilization. Filed as infra-ops#122.

maria_eng: Agreed. Also add routing rule test in integration to simulate full pools so spillover triggers in tests. Filed: eng-test#344.

kevin_api: For immediate customer mitigation, can the API return a clear Retry-After header for throttled requests? We currently return generic 429.

aj_infra: We can patch the edge LB to include `Retry-After` quickly. Patching now.

incident_bot: Deploy recorded: edge-lb/patch retry-after header by aj_infra — success

elena_ops: Handing off to on-call evening shift at 18:00 UTC. Current state: spillover forced to EU & APNE, queues stable, asia pool at 98% but not growing, cloud ticket pending.

sre_oncall: Ack. Leaving note: next steps if cloud quota denied — continue forced spillover, consider temporary increase to spillover target weights, and escalate to infra leads.

beth_support: Customer comms scheduled: status page + direct for 2 impacted paying customers.

cust_success_jose: Confirmed recipients notified.

maria_eng: Postmortem action items so far: * increase asia reserved capacity * emergency burst automation * capacity-based routing logic + test coverage * Retry-After for throttles * synth alerts for pool utilization.

elena_ops: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up after cloud ticket. If anything changes, @sre_oncall or I will reopen the thread. :white_check_mark:

incident_bot: Incident P1 acknowledged. Channel: #incidents. Timeline logging enabled.
